title: A simple guide

# A simple guide

This guide is designed to introduce new junior golfers and their parents to the essential equipment needed for the sport. Understanding the basics of golf clubs and gear is crucial for a positive start in golfing.

In this learning pack, we will explore:  
- The different types of golf clubs  
- How to choose the right clubs for juniors  
- What you should find in a basic golf bag  
- Tips for getting fitted for clubs  

By following this guide, you will build a solid foundation for your golfing journey. Let's get started!
pageSummary: An introduction to the essential equipment for junior golfers.
